shellCommands.command: cd /workspace && find app __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "--- tsconfig" && cat tsconfig.json

grep -rn "refresh" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== types ==="; grep -rn "export function refresh\|declare function refresh" node_modules/next/dist/server/request/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/api/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

grep -n "useFormStatus\|useActionState\|refresh(" 02-guides/interactive-apps.md 02-guides/server-actions.md | head -30; echo "=== cookies ==="; grep -n "await cookies\|Server Action" 03-api-reference/04-functions/cookies.md | head -20
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && echo "TSC_DONE" && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -12

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ -o /tmp/page1.html -c /tmp/cj.txt; grep -o 'name="\$ACTION[^"]*"[^>]*' /tmp/page1.html | head -5; echo "--- state:"; grep -o '[^<]*' /tmp/page1.html

cd /tmp && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3111/ -b /tmp/cj.txt -F '$ACTION_ID_00b26aab789bd756444b4297c0e975245ceed75b55=' -o /tmp/post1.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n"; echo "--- state after toggle:"; grep -o '[^<]*' /tmp/post1.html; echo "--- fresh GET:"; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ -b /tmp/cj.txt | grep -o '[^<]*'

curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3111/ -b /tmp/cj.txt -F '$ACTION_ID_00b26aab789bd756444b4297c0e975245ceed75b55=' -D /tmp/h.txt -o /tmp/post2.html; echo "--- headers:"; grep -iE "^(HTTP/|location|x-nextjs)" /tmp/h.txt; echo "--- state after 2nd toggle:"; grep -o '[^<]*' /tmp/post2.html; pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server"; true
